data.one_liner: Removes common accents and diacritical signs from strings.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple function to strip common accents and diacritical marks from a given string, replacing them with equivalent non-accented characters. Useful for normalization, search indexing, or handling text input without special characters.
use_when: You need to normalize user input by removing diacritics.
You are building a search or filtering feature that should ignore accents.
avoid_when: You need full internationalization or locale-aware collation rules beyond simple character replacement.
strengths: Extremely simple and lightweight with no external dependencies.
Works across all Dart platforms including web, mobile, and desktop.
weaknesses: Provides a very narrow, single-purpose functionality.
Does not handle advanced locale-specific string normalization rules.
